analysis.title: Rivian Automotive Inc. (RIVN): Solid 3Q results; R2 ramp, autonomy platform, and cost outlook in focus from here
key_insights: Rivian reported 3Q26 revenue of $2,155 mn vs GS $2,082 mn and Street (FactSet) $2,001 mn. Adjusted EBITDA ex. SBC was -$435 mn vs GS -$666 mn and Street -$586 mn, both above the Street even excluding regulatory credits.

Regulatory credit revenue was $81 mn in 3Q26 vs GS assumption of $0. It was a key driver of the GAAP gross profit beat ($176 mn vs GS -$95 mn). Rivian also cited a ~$120 mn headwind from R2 ramp costs and a modest benefit from an IEEPA tariff refund receivable.

2026 adjusted EBITDA (ex. SBC) loss guidance improved to -$1,850 mn to -$1,750 mn from -$2,000 mn to -$1,800 mn, about $100 mn better at the midpoint. GS prior was -$1,893 mn and the Street -$1,887 mn. The improvement came from higher regulatory credit revenue, the IEEPA tariff refund receivable in 3Q and higher expected deliveries.
Implied 4Q26 adjusted EBITDA guidance is -$514 mn at the midpoint, a larger loss than GS prior (-$376 mn) and the Street (-$446 mn).

2026 deliveries guidance low end raised to 67.0K-70.0K from 65.0K-70.0K. Midpoint is 68.5K vs GS prior 67.3K and Street (Visible Alpha) 67.1K. Implied 4Q26 deliveries are 26.7K at the midpoint vs GS prior 25.4K and Visible Alpha 25.5K.
2026 capex guidance was cut to $1,400-$1,500 mn from $1,700-$1,800 mn on timing of spend. Rivian expects a meaningful step up in 2027 as the Georgia manufacturing facility ramps.
R2 outsold both R1 and EDV in 3Q26, and Rivian started its second R2 production shift. Rivian still expects positive automotive segment gross profit exiting 2026 as R2 ramps.

3Q26 FCF was -$1,124 mn and capex was $366 mn. Rivian ended the quarter with $5.5 bn of cash and investments and $7.1 bn of total liquidity. Total available liquidity and targeted future capital is $13 bn, including the DOE loan and potential Uber and VW investments.

Autonomy: a point-to-point Autonomy Early Access Program rolls out to select users later this year, with general availability to all Autonomy+ subscribers in 2027. Rivian is on track for the second milestone of its Uber robotaxi partnership by year-end, which unlocks $250 mn. The remaining $700 mn comes across three milestones tied to L4-capable R2 robotaxi deployment.

EDV: new variants began delivering to Amazon in October, including an AWD configuration and a larger battery pack with ~30% more range. Other commercial operators have shown interest in the EDV platform. The VW JV's first vehicle using Rivian technology, the ~€20K ID. EVERY1, is expected to launch next year, and the remaining $460 mn of VW capital commitments is expected in late 2027.

GS maintains Neutral and cuts the 12-month price target to $13 from $16, based on 1.5X (from 1.75X, reflecting lower market multiples) applied to Q5-Q8 revenue estimates. GS expects margins and FCF to stay pressured over the medium term by rising input costs and higher opex.

GS 2026/27/28 delivery estimates move to 68.5K/143.0K/200.0K from 67.3K/139.0K/200.0K. EPS including SBC moves to -$2.72/-$2.70/-$2.30 from -$2.93/-$2.60/-$2.20. EPS excluding SBC is -$2.09/-$2.10/-$1.70.

market_movers.rationale: GS cuts the target to $13 from $16 on a lower revenue multiple (1.5X vs 1.75X) and keeps Neutral. The 3Q26 results were a positive, but margins and FCF are expected to stay pressured by input costs and opex.

earnings_insights: RIVN 3Q26 reported revenue $2,155 mn vs GS est $2,082 mn and Street (FactSet) est $2,001 mn; +38.3% y/y, +30.0% q/q.
RIVN 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA ex. SBC reported -$435 mn vs GS est -$666 mn and Street (FactSet) est -$586 mn.
RIVN 3Q26 adjusted EPS ex. SBC reported -$0.48 vs GS est -$0.73 and Street est -$0.64. GS estimates EPS including SBC at -$0.62 vs GS est -$0.89.

RIVN 3Q26 GAAP gross profit reported $176 mn vs GS est -$95 mn. Automotive GAAP gross profit was -$80 mn vs GS est -$322 mn. Software, services and other GAAP gross profit was $256 mn vs GS est $228 mn.

RIVN 3Q26 deliveries were 19,248, +57.8% q/q and +45.8% y/y. Automotive revenue ex. regulatory credits was $1,469 mn vs GS est $1,432 mn. Software, services and other ex. regulatory credits was $605 mn vs GS est $650 mn.

RIVN 2026 guidance: adjusted EBITDA ex. SBC -$1,850 mn to -$1,750 mn (prior -$2,000 mn to -$1,800 mn), deliveries 67.0K-70.0K (prior 65.0K-70.0K), capex $1,400-$1,500 mn (prior $1,700-$1,800 mn). Midpoint comparisons: GS prior est -$1,893 mn EBITDA and Street est -$1,887 mn; GS prior est 67.3K deliveries and Visible Alpha est 67.1K.

GS FY estimates (forecast): revenue $7,925 mn in 2026E, $12,438 mn in 2027E and $15,608 mn in 2028E, up from $7,727 mn, $12,060 mn and $15,500 mn. EBITDA is -$2,618 mn, -$2,143 mn and -$1,499 mn. FCF is -$3,592 mn, -$3,733 mn and -$3,894 mn.
risk_factors: Margins, including rising input costs and higher opex
4Q26 implied EBITDA guidance is a larger loss than the Street expected, and the 2026 EBITDA guidance raise relied partly on regulatory credits and a tariff refund receivable

tension_points.bull_case: R2 outsold R1 and EDV in 3Q26, a second R2 shift started, the company expects positive automotive gross profit exiting 2026, and GS sees large R2 market potential.
tension_points.bear_case: GS expects overall margins and FCF to stay pressured over the medium term by rising input costs and higher opex, with a ~$120 mn R2 ramp cost headwind in 3Q26 and a larger implied 4Q26 EBITDA loss than the Street expected.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Positive automotive segment gross profit not being achieved exiting 2026 as R2 ramps.
